steps.what: List compliance procedures due for periodic internal review
Conduct internal reviews or audits to ensure procedures are followed

tasks.design: The manager conducts periodic internal reviews or audits to ensure that compliance procedures are followed. {DOCS} lists a procedure only when a stored last-review date plus a stored interval is due. A blank interval stops that row and is not guessed. The manager still conducts the review, at full effort. The list does not find a breach.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager kept a diary of reviews and then did the audit.
tasks.enabler_now: A due list can be calculated from a stored date and a stored interval. The audit stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a procedure was followed stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager rejects a due date that invents an interval.
tasks.altitude: The due list is clerical. The review and the audit stay at full effort.

reach.task: Show the procedure the manager named

evidence.claim: A due date can be calculated from a stored last-review date and a stored interval. Conducting the review stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with the procedure register and ends when the manager has reviewed, or stops.
A procedure row has identifier, last-review date, and interval, entered by the manager. A blank interval is left blank. That row is not listed.
The list does not decide that a procedure was followed. The rules are those in force.
unknowns: Which procedures have an interval the manager has set.
research_questions: How often was an interval blank?

already_counted.description: Conducting the review is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct an interval before the list is used.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: intervals are often blank, so the manager still chooses what to review. High: intervals are stored, the due rows are listed, and the manager still conducts the review. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Stay informed regarding pending industry changes
Note trends or practices before acting on them

tasks.design: The manager keeps informed regarding pending industry changes, trends, or best practices. The reading stays at full effort. No feed is scraped, and an already-running news list is not counted as saved labour. The manager decides what matters.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager read the changes and decided what applied.
tasks.still_hard: Which change matters stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not treat an unread item as understood.
tasks.altitude: Staying informed stays at full effort. No feed is counted as saved labour.

reach.task: Hear which changes the manager will act on
reach.learn: Which items the manager set aside.

evidence.claim: Staying informed on industry changes stays with the manager. An existing news list is not saved labour.

assumptions: The brief is the policy, case, or site the manager already holds. A blank field is left blank.
No employee, auditor, or caller is scored. Upkeep is zero.
The rules applied are those in force. No foreign filing process is invented.
unknowns: Which of these judgements the manager will not delegate.
research_questions: How often did the manager stop rather than decide?

already_counted.description: This judgement is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the judgement adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every change is still read by the manager. High: the same reading remains, with no feed counted as saved labour. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Total stored exception counts for compliance systems
Monitor compliance systems to ensure their effectiveness

tasks.design: The manager monitors compliance systems to ensure their effectiveness. {SPREADSHEET} only totals exception lines the manager has already logged. A missing line is omitted and is not zero. This is hand addition, not an already-running monitor. The manager still judges effectiveness, at full effort. The total does not declare a system effective.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager added the exceptions and judged the system.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored exception lines can be totalled. The judgement stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a system is effective stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager rejects a total that treats a missing line as zero.
tasks.altitude: The total is clerical. Judging effectiveness stays at full effort.

reach.task: Hear the judgement the manager reached

evidence.claim: Stored exception lines can be totalled. Judging whether a compliance system is effective stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with the period and ends when the manager has judged effectiveness, or stops.
An exception line has system identifier and count, entered by the manager. A missing line is omitted and is not stored as zero.
An already-running monitor, if one exists, is not counted as saved labour. The total does not declare a system effective.
unknowns: Which systems the manager logs exceptions for.
research_questions: How often was an exception line missing?

already_counted.description: Judging effectiveness is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct an exception line before the total is used.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: lines are often missing, so the manager still rebuilds the picture. High: lines are complete, the total is shown, and the manager still judges effectiveness. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Direct the development of policies and procedures related to compliance

tasks.design: The manager directs the development or implementation of policies and procedures related to compliance throughout an organization. The direction stays at full effort. A template does not write the policy or order the rollout.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager directed the drafting and the rollout.
tasks.enabler_now: No plan directs the organisation by itself.
tasks.still_hard: What is developed, and how it is implemented, stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager stops a rollout the policy does not support.

reach.task: Draft only what the manager has directed

evidence.claim: Directing policy development and implementation stays with the manager.

assumptions: The brief is the policy, case, or site the manager already holds. A blank field is left blank.
No employee, auditor, or caller is scored. Upkeep is zero.
The rules applied are those in force. No foreign filing process is invented.
unknowns: Which of these judgements the manager will not delegate.
research_questions: How often did the manager stop rather than decide?

already_counted.description: This judgement is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the judgement adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every policy program is still directed by the manager. High: the same direction remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The compliance manager still judges a breach, a sanction, and a policy change. A policy or a report is sent or filed only after the manager accepts that version.
reach: An employee reaches the manager directly with a confidential report.
A colleague receives only a policy the manager has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required flag, interval, or figure is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep investigations, sanctions, and policy changes in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every management report traces to a stored figure, and the manager still writes what it means.
